title: Math
description: Hissab supports all standard math operations.

title: Brackets
description: Group expressions inside () brackets to override default operator precedence and get predictable results

title: Permutations
description: Permutation relates to the act of arranging all the members of a set into some sequence or order.

title: Combinations
description: Combination is a way of selecting items from a collection, such that (unlike permutations) the order of selection does not matter.

title: Factorial
description: Factorial of a non-negative integer n, denoted by n!, is the product of all positive integers less than or equal to n

title: Modulas
description: Find remainder when number divides another number

title: Percentage
description: You can perform various operations with percentages.

title: Unit conversion
description: Hissab supports all standard and popular units for the following types: Length, Area, Volume, Weight, Angle, Temperature, Data, Duration, Postfixes.

title: Dates
description: Supported Date formats: dd.mm.yyyy (15.03.2020), mm.dd.yyyy (03.15.2020), dd mmm yyyy (15 mar 2020), yyyy mmm dd (2020 mar 15)
example:
15 mar 2020 + 10 days
15 mar 2020 - 23 jul 2010 to days

title: now
description: Get current date and time

title: today
description: Get today's date

title: tomorrow
description: Get tomorrow's date

title: yesterday
description: Get yesterday's date

title: Timezone
description: Find current time at any timezone or city. You can also convert any time from one timezone to another.
example:
now in pst
4 pm ist to denver

title: Variables
description: Store results for any expression in a variable of any name, which can be referenced in any other expression.

title: prev
description: Refer previous line's result.

title: total
tag: sum of all lines, add all lines
description: Find total of all above lines

title: Functions
description: Functions allow to compute complex calculations with an easy interface.

title: sum
description: Function to add multiple values

title: avg
description: Function to find average of multiple values

title: Number systems
tag: binary, octal, decimal, hexadecimal, base 2, base 10, base 8, base 16
description: Hissab supports varions number systems like binary, octal and hexadecimal along with decimal.

title: Bitwise operations
description: Hissab supports various bitwise operations like AND, OR, XOR, NOT etc.
